verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents official client libraries in multiple languages, including C++ and an idiomatic Python interface, which expose its core functionality. Code generators let nodes written in different libraries interoperate, and the install docs verify both the C++ and Python APIs; one community comment adds that LLMs handle ROS boilerplate well. However, several features are documented as C++-only (intra-process communication, composition, managed lifecycles, content filtering), so the SDKs do not have feature parity. missing for 10: feature parity across language SDKs (Python lacks several C++-only features), independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, any AI-native-specific SDK tooling or guidance.
